meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已写好或半成品的小说反向拆解成可继续写作的项目结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有半成品或完本小说,想接着往下写。
copy.tagline_en: Turn an existing or half-finished novel into a project structure you can keep writing in
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a half-finished or complete novel and want to keep writing it.

howto.what: 把已写完或写到一半的小说反向解析成可续写的项目结构——设定、大纲、正文、追踪，并生成拆文库分析资产。长篇和短篇按篇幅自动分流走不同路径。
howto.when: 当你说「/story-import」「导入小说」等指令，或想把已有小说导进来接着写时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这本写到一半的小说导进来，做成能续写的工程
say.note: 先拆文分析，再迁移成项目结构

say.text: 导入我的书《XX》，起点平台，长篇
say.note: 确认篇幅后走长篇迁移路径

say.text: 已有小说续写，先 setup 还是先 import？
say.note: 会先直接给出流程结论

howto.what_en: Reverse-parses a finished or half-written novel into a resumable writing project (settings, outline, chapters, tracking) plus a breakdown library. Long and short works are routed automatically by length.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /story-import or say "import novel", or want to bring an existing book in for continued writing.

say_en.text: Import my half-written novel and rebuild it as a resumable project
say_en.note: It analyzes the text, then migrates it into a project

say_en.text: Import my book 《XX》, Qidian platform, long-form
say_en.note: Length detection picks the long-form migration path

say_en.text: For an existing novel, run setup or import first?
say_en.note: It gives the flow answer first
